description: Defines an abstract class 'TypeResolver' that provides interface methods for resolving a .NET 'Type' from a string name, including 'ResolveType' which throws on failure and 'TryResolveType' which returns a success boolean.

classes.name: TypeResolver
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to resolve a Type from a string name.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the Type corresponding to a string name, throws an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method that attempts to resolve a Type from a string name, returning a boolean indicating success.
